description: Compress bulky new context before you reason over it: tool output, logs, stack traces, test/build runs, diffs over ~150 lines (~2K tokens), long file reads, search results, docs, pasted documents. Pass only the new text as `context` (not the whole history) and the user's request verbatim as `query`; work from the returned digest. Never compress the request itself or code you are about to edit. Already-seen chunks are skipped and rolling session memory is compacted automatically.

context.description: Only the new bulky text to compress (not previously sent this session)

query.description: The user's request, verbatim — used to decide what to keep; never compressed

session_id.description: Optional session id for rolling memory (defaults to mcp)

name: compress_context
